documents.title: September Close Post-Mortem — Business Central API
documents.excerpt: The BC API timed out under month-end volume on WD+1 and WD+2. Finance rebuilt GL and intercompany balances from the Data Lake by hand; close completed at WD+11.

documents.title: POS Roll-out — Chain Cut-over Calendar
documents.excerpt: Intersport and Anton Sport live on the new POS; Sport 1 cut-over during November. Item master moves from supplier article numbers to EAN.

documents.title: Store-Owner Settlement Terms — Intersport & Sport 1
documents.excerpt: Group invoices goods, marketing-fund contributions and shared services to locally owned stores. Balances must be agreed per store before eliminations are posted.

documents.title: Winter Inbound Plan — Alpine & Outerwear
documents.excerpt: 312 purchase orders received in the warehouse but not yet invoiced at WD+2. Peak inbound week 43; volume-rebate tier reached with two brand suppliers.

documents.title: Card & Vipps MobilePay Settlement Formats
documents.excerpt: Settlements arrive T+2 net of fees. New file layout from the acquirer since the POS change; gross-to-net matching needs a fee-schedule rule.

documents.title: October Cycle Count Results — East Stores
documents.excerpt: Shrink at 1.8% vs 1.1% budget in four East stores, concentrated in electronics and ski goggles. Recount requested from store owners.

documents.title: Aged Stock Report — Summer Outdoor
documents.excerpt: NOK 9.8M of tents, bikes and paddle boards older than 180 days in franchise stores. Markdown decision needed before the January sale.

documents.title: Click-and-Collect Freight Allocation
documents.excerpt: Orders picked in Intersport stores still carry full parcel freight in the web P&L. Proposed move to the store-fulfilment rate card.

documents.title: Leadership Business Case — Data Platform (draft)
documents.excerpt: 10-slide case for data-platform modernisation. Lead argument: a month-end close that does not break under volume and does not depend on consultant scripts.

documents.title: Seasonal Staffing — Winter Contracts
documents.excerpt: 140 seasonal staff contracted in October with November start dates. Holiday pay (feriepenger, 10.2%) accrues on onboarding hours.
